title.en: Histogram, frequency polygon and frequency curve
title.kn: ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ, ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಬಹುಭುಜ ಮತ್ತು ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರ

hook.en: Marks are continuous: 29.9 and 30 are neighbours. So the bars of a marks distribution must touch each other. That is a histogram.
hook.kn: ಅಂಕಗಳು ನಿರಂತರ: 29.9 ಮತ್ತು 30 ನೆರೆಹೊರೆಯವು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅಂಕ ವಿತರಣೆಯ ಸ್ತಂಭಗಳು ಒಂದನ್ನೊಂದು ಮುಟ್ಟಬೇಕು. ಅದೇ ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ.

objectives.en: Draw a histogram for equal and unequal classes

narration.en: Marks are continuous: 29.9 and 30 are neighbours. So the bars of a marks distribution must touch each other. That is a histogram.
narration.kn: ಅಂಕಗಳು ನಿರಂತರ: 29.9 ಮತ್ತು 30 ನೆರೆಹೊರೆಯವು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅಂಕ ವಿತರಣೆಯ ಸ್ತಂಭಗಳು ಒಂದನ್ನೊಂದು ಮುಟ್ಟಬೇಕು. ಅದೇ ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ.

body.en: A histogram is a set of adjacent rectangles drawn on the class intervals of a continuous frequency distribution, with areas proportional to the frequencies. For equal classes, heights are the frequencies. For unequal classes, use adjusted frequency = f × (standard width ÷ class width) as the height. Inclusive classes are first converted to class boundaries. The mode can be located from a histogram.
body.kn: ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ ನಿರಂತರ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಿತರಣೆಯ ವರ್ಗಾಂತರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಕ್ಕಪಕ್ಕದ ಆಯತಗಳು; ಅವುಗಳ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತ. ಅಸಮ ವರ್ಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ = f × (ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಅಗಲ ÷ ವರ್ಗದ ಅಗಲ).

say.en: Marks of 40 students in classes 10 to 60. Draw rectangles on the class intervals, touching each other.
Mark the mid-point of the top of each rectangle: 15, 25, 35, 45, 55.
Join them and close the polygon at 5 and 65, the mid-points of the empty classes on either side.
Smooth the polygon freehand and you get the frequency curve.

narration.en: On the board: Histogram to frequency polygon.

Drag the tops of the rectangles to set the frequencies of four classes of width 10. The frequency polygon joins the mid-points of the tops and is closed at the mid-points of the empty classes on either side. Merge the last two classes into 20–40 and see why its height must be adjusted to f × 10 ÷ 20.

caption.en: Drag the tops of the rectangles to set the frequencies of four classes of width 10. The frequency polygon joins the mid-points of the tops and is closed at the mid-points of the empty classes on either side. Merge the last two classes into 20–40 and see why its height must be adjusted to f × 10 ÷ 20.
caption.kn: ವರ್ಗಾಂತರ 10 ರ ನಾಲ್ಕು ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಆಯತಗಳ ತುದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಬಹುಭುಜವು ತುದಿಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಯ ಖಾಲಿ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೊನೆಯ ಎರಡು ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು 20–40 ಆಗಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿ; ಅದರ ಎತ್ತರವನ್ನು f × 10 ÷ 20 ಗೆ ಏಕೆ ಸರಿಹೊಂದಿಸಬೇಕು ನೋಡಿ.

tryThis.en: Turn on the frequency polygon. Where does it start and end on the x-axis?
Merge 20–40 without adjusting. Does the picture still show the same data fairly?
Now adjust the height. Compare the area of the merged bar with the two bars it replaced.

text.en: f = {F2_y + F3_y}, height {if(adj, (F2_y + F3_y)/2, F2_y + F3_y)}
unequal class not adjusted: its area is doubled!

body.en: A frequency polygon is obtained by joining the mid-points of the tops of the histogram rectangles with straight lines and closing it at the mid-points of the classes just before and after (with zero frequency). It can also be drawn directly by plotting frequencies against mid-values. A frequency curve is a smooth freehand curve through these points; it shows the shape of the distribution.
body.kn: ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ಬಹುಭುಜ: ಆಯತಗಳ ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗದ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಳರೇಖೆಗಳಿಂದ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮುಚ್ಚುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರ: ಈ ಬಿಂದುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ನಯವಾದ ವಕ್ರ.

caption.en: Classes of unequal width: 0–10, 10–20, 20–40 and 40–80. The bars show adjusted heights f × 10 ÷ width, which is what a histogram must use.

tryThis.en: Give 40–80 the largest frequency. Is its rectangle the tallest?
What frequency must 20–40 have to be as tall as 10–20?

narration.en: Classes of unequal width: 0–10, 10–20, 20–40 and 40–80. The bars show adjusted heights f × 10 ÷ width, which is what a histogram must use.

problem.en: Classes 0–10: 5, 10–20: 12, 20–40: 20, 40–70: 18. Find the heights of the histogram rectangles (standard width 10).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classes 0–10: 5, 10–20: 12, 20–40: 20, 40–70: 18. Find the heights of the histogram rectangles (standard width 10).
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Exam practice. These questions are in the Karnataka PU Statistics examination pattern. Try them before checking the answer.

points.en: A histogram has adjacent rectangles with area ∝ frequency.
For unequal widths, height = f × standard width ÷ width.
points.kn: ಅಸಮ ಅಗಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತರ = f × ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಅಗಲ ÷ ಅಗಲ.

points.en: Polygon: join mid-points of tops, close at both ends.
points.kn: ಬಹುಭುಜ: ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗದ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿ.

points.en: Frequency curve: a smooth freehand curve.

homework.en: Draw a histogram and frequency polygon for: 0–10: 3, 10–20: 7, 20–30: 12, 30–40: 6, 40–50: 2.

narration.en: Recap. A histogram has adjacent rectangles with area ∝ frequency. For unequal widths, height = f × standard width ÷ width. Polygon: join mid-points of tops, close at both ends. Frequency curve: a smooth freehand curve.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಕ್ಕಪಕ್ಕದ ಆಯತಗಳು; ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ∝ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ. ಅಸಮ ಅಗಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತರ = f × ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಅಗಲ ÷ ಅಗಲ. ಬಹುಭುಜ: ಮೇಲ್ಭಾಗದ ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿ. ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ವಕ್ರ: ನಯವಾದ ಕೈರೇಖೆ ವಕ್ರ.
